statement: Total reality holds with one or two line tangencies: the sharp maxima are 6 and 36, respectively.

source.location: Theorem 1 and §2.2 for two tangencies; Ronga §4, Theorem, for one tangency

scope: Smooth irreducible degree-4 plane curves; all incidence points and lines real and general.
notes: Here k denotes the number of tangent-line conditions. Other k are not settled by these cited statements.
